skill.name: frontend-ui-dark-ts
skill.description: A modern dark-themed React UI system using Tailwind CSS and Framer Motion. Designed for dashboards, admin panels, and data-rich applications with glassmorphism effects and tasteful animations.
skill.summary: React, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion patterns for dark dashboards and admin interfaces.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: Most static hits are Markdown formatting, frontend code examples, placeholder URLs, or CSS asset paths. The only confirmed issue is the Quick Start npm and npx command block, which should require user confirmation because it runs package manager tooling. No semantic prompt injection, data exfiltration intent, or deceptive authority claims were found.

remediation.issue: Package manager commands in Quick Start
remediation.suggestion: Keep npm and npx steps as user-run setup commands, require confirmation before execution, and pin dependency versions where possible.
Replace example.com Open Graph and Twitter URLs with project-owned URLs before production deployment.

content.value_statement: Dark admin interfaces need consistent styling, motion, and responsive structure. This skill provides React, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion patterns for dashboards and data tools.
actual_capabilities: Defines a React, Vite, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS project setup.
Lists required packages for routing, animation, styling, and build tooling.
Provides Tailwind theme tokens for colors, radii, shadows, spacing, and animations.
Shows global CSS for dark mode, font faces, focus rings, scrollbars, and glass utilities.
Includes React routing and page transition examples using Framer Motion.
Documents typography and color class choices for common UI elements.
limitations: It is documentation only and does not include packaged source files.
Example asset URLs and app names must be replaced before production use.
Accessibility, browser support, and performance need project-specific testing.
It does not provide backend, authentication, or data fetching patterns.

use_cases.title: Create a Dashboard Foundation
use_cases.description: Use the skill to plan a dark React dashboard with routes, layout, tokens, and motion patterns.

use_cases.title: Standardize Product UI
use_cases.description: Translate a dark visual direction into shared Tailwind classes, typography rules, and component behavior.

use_cases.title: Prototype an Admin Panel
use_cases.description: Build a consistent first version of internal tools with glass surfaces, sidebar layout, and status colors.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Dark React App
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a new dashboard project.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the frontend-ui-dark-ts skill to plan a new Vite React TypeScript dashboard. Include dependencies, folders, theme setup, and first screen components.

prompt_templates.title: Style an Existing Page
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate redesign of an existing React page.
prompt_templates.prompt: Apply this dark UI system to my existing React page. Preserve the workflow, improve spacing and contrast, and list every component to update.

prompt_templates.title: Create Component Patterns
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced component planning for a reusable UI kit.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design reusable Button, Card, Input, Dialog, Tabs, Sidebar, and PageHeader patterns with this skill. Include state, motion, accessibility, and responsive behavior.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Design Consistency
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review for an existing dashboard.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my dashboard against this skill. Identify token drift, layout gaps, motion problems, and missing production checks with prioritized fixes.

output_examples.input: Create a dark admin dashboard shell.
output_examples.output: The result is a responsive shell with sidebar navigation, page header, glass surfaces, status colors, and motion guidance.

output_examples.input: Improve a settings page with this design system.
output: A tighter visual hierarchy for titles, labels, and body text.
Tailwind class guidance for inputs, cards, and focus states.
Motion suggestions for dialogs and tab changes.

output_examples.input: Prepare a UI handoff for a React team.
output_examples.output: The skill returns a structured summary of tokens, component patterns, asset requirements, and implementation notes for the team.

best_practices: Replace placeholder names, URLs, and images before sharing or deploying the app.
Confirm npm and npx setup commands before running them in any workspace.
Test contrast, keyboard focus, and responsive layout on real target screens.
anti_patterns: Do not copy the examples without adapting app identity, routes, and assets.
Do not run package manager commands automatically from an unreviewed community skill.
Do not use glass effects where readability or performance is already weak.

faq.question: Does this skill generate a complete application?
faq.answer: No. It provides setup guidance, theme tokens, CSS patterns, and React examples for a dark interface.

faq.question: Which frameworks does it target?
faq.answer: It targets React with TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, React Router, and Framer Motion.

faq.question: Can it redesign an existing page?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide the current page and ask for changes based on the documented tokens and component patterns.

faq.question: Does it include accessibility checks?
faq.answer: It includes focus and touch target guidance, but full accessibility testing remains project-specific.

faq.question: Are the example URLs production-ready?
faq.answer: No. The example.com social metadata URLs are placeholders and should be replaced.

faq.question: Should setup commands run automatically?
faq.answer: No. Package manager commands should be reviewed and confirmed before execution.
